description: A Premier League club's upcoming games, in date order, with kick-off times, grounds and UK TV where confirmed. Filter by competition if asked ("Chelsea's Champions League fixtures"). Default 5 games, at most 20.

club.description: A Premier League club, as people write it: "Arsenal", "Spurs", "Man Utd", "Brighton", "Forest".

competition.description: Optional: Premier League, FA Cup, Carabao Cup, Champions League, Europa League, Conference League, "Europe" (all three UEFA competitions) or "cups" (FA Cup and Carabao Cup).

timezone.description: Optional IANA time zone for an extra local kick-off time, e.g. "America/New_York". UK time is always included.

name: fixtures
title: Fixtures
